faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about AI SVG Generator.

items.question: Is this AI SVG generator really free with no sign up?
items.answer: Yes! You can generate, vectorize, and preview vector files directly in your browser without creating an account or entering a credit card. Free users get 2 full exports daily, with full interactive canvas access.

items.question: How does this prevent 'node soup' for Cricut and laser cutters?
items.answer: Traditional tracing tools (like Inkscape Trace Bitmap) blindly follow anti-aliased pixels, generating thousands of chaotic anchor points that freeze Cricut Design Space. Our engine uses Ramer-Douglas-Peucker (RDP) curve-fitting algorithms to streamline paths down to under 120 smooth nodes.

items.question: Can I convert my existing PNG, JPG, or WebP images to SVG?
items.answer: Yes. Switch to the 'PNG to SVG' tab on the studio canvas to upload any raster artwork, customer sketch, or Midjourney image. The AI cleans up fuzzy edges and extracts true Bézier curves.

items.question: Does it support layered SVGs for multi-color vinyl cutting?
items.answer: Yes. The engine automatically clusters colors and groups paths into separate compound paths by color. You can toggle each layer on/off, change colors with the picker, and import cleanly into Cricut Design Space.

items.question: Can I use the exported SVGs commercially on Etsy or Print-on-Demand?
items.answer: Yes. All SVGs generated through AI SVG Generator include full commercial rights for Etsy SVG bundles, physical vinyl crafts, POD apparel (Printful, Printify), and digital client deliverables.

items.question: Why is this better than Adobe Illustrator Image Trace or Inkscape?
items.answer: Illustrator and Inkscape require heavy manual cleanup with the Pen tool, Pathfinder booleans, and anchor point simplification. AI SVG Generator automates all topological cleanup, path closure, and node economy in under 5 seconds.

items.question: What is physical trapping offset and why is it essential for multi-color vinyl crafts?
items.answer: When creating multi-color HTV (Heat Transfer Vinyl) or permanent adhesive vinyl decals, heat-press application causes vinyl material to shrink slightly along the seams. Traditional vector tools leave zero tolerance, causing unsightly white gaps between colors. Our AI geometric engine automatically calculates an engineered 0.2mm to 0.5mm choke overlap (trapping) between adjacent color layers, ensuring perfectly aligned, seamless physical press results without any light leaks.

items.question: How do strictly closed paths (Z-command) protect Cricut blades and laser cutters?
items.answer: CNC cutting machines, Roland plotters, xTool lasers, and Cricut blades require strictly closed geometric loops ending with standard SVG 'Z' or 'z' commands. Unclosed paths or micro self-intersecting loops cause cutting heads to stutter, double-cut the same pixel, or tear delicate cardstock and vinyl. AI SVG Generator guarantees 100% watertight, non-self-intersecting closed contours that allow your machine's toolhead to glide smoothly in one continuous stroke.

items.question: Can developers copy clean React JSX vector icons directly into TailwindCSS or Shadcn UI?
items.answer: Yes. Switch to 'Minimalist Icon' profile or click the 'JSX' copy button in the studio canvas. You receive production-ready React component code formatted with camelCase SVG attributes (fillRule, clipRule), responsive viewBox coordinates, and currentColor styling that seamlessly adapts to dark/light theme switching and Tailwind utility classes.

items.question: How does client-side WebAssembly vectorization protect my image privacy and speed up processing?
items.answer: When converting PNG, JPG, or WebP images to vectors, our pipeline utilizes high-performance WebAssembly (WASM) running directly inside your modern browser sandbox. Your proprietary sketches, customer logos, and private artwork never leave your device for server processing, delivering instantaneous Bézier curve extraction with zero upload latency and bank-grade privacy.

items.question: Can I use this as an AI SVG logo generator for branding and commercial projects?
items.answer: Yes! AI SVG Generator is engineered for creating scalable vector logos, vintage craft emblems, monogram insignias, and modern web icons. Every generated SVG comes with full commercial rights, perfectly suited for client brand identities, website logos, and physical print collateral.

items.question: What file formats are supported for input raster conversion and vector export?
items.answer: For raster input, we support PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images up to 25MB. For export, you can download Cricut-ready SVGs with grouped compound paths, laser-ready watertight cut files, web-optimized SVG assets, and clean production React JSX component code.

items.question: How does the vector engine handle intricate font outlines and lettering?
items.answer: Our geometric pipeline automatically converts typography and script lettering into unified solid vector contours with zero missing font errors. All glyphs are converted to native Bézier paths so Cricut, Silhouette, and laser cutters can cut letterforms perfectly without requiring installed desktop fonts.
